scope: QA independent review of S7b2 (81-slot megakernel shading/RGB): own fixture decode and own pinned-3.15 reference re-capture, own harness render dumps, packed ABGR / unpacked f32 / depth-ULP / seg comparison over 120,000 pixels, new camera pose and two modified mat_shininess values to test the mat_shin_exp semantic fix, four-way light-pose check, 81-slot signature/order/placeholder/bvh-blob audit, A-prime render gate and PTX facts, rejection surface, determinism, run-hash recomputation, evidence integrity and diff scope, delivered suites and fmt/clippy/unit gates rerun. Fast-loop scope; no full G01; no product/fixture/original-evidence changes.

method.harness: target/qa-s7b2-harness (QA-owned crate, product crate path dependency + cuda-probe; own model/scene/camera/fixture decoding; does not include tests/support/**)
method.reference: target/qa-s7b2/capture_qa.py (pinned venv Python 3.12.13 / warp 1.15.0 / mujoco 3.15.0 / mujoco_warp 3.15.0 / numpy 2.5.4; PARAMS_28 with use_fast_math=False, the agreed reference recipe only; QA computes every comparison itself)

reference_reproduction.note: QA re-capture from pinned 3.15 reproduces the delivered same-recipe fixture bit-for-bit; the S0b-derived rgb.json is reproduced from reference/rgb.npz with rint(*255) -> pack ABGR

run_hashes.note: QA recomputes both hashes from its own RGBA/depth/seg word dumps; RGB uses the delivered test's fold(0u64) seed

cross_recipe_deviation.treatment: recorded known cross-recipe deviation only; not a pass criterion and not a product defect

new_pose_generalization.reference: QA pinned-3.15 re-capture with mjm.cam_pos shifted; poses passed to product as f32 bit patterns

reference_source_semantics.mat_shin_exp: var_341 = mat_shininess[mat_id] * 128.0 (var_340 = 128.0); var_353 = where(mat_id>=0, var_341, 64.0 default)
reference_source_semantics.headlight_call: line 9432 compute_lighting(..., var_352, var_353, ...) -> headlight specular exponent is the material value

mat_shin_exp_semantic.product_code: render_megakernel.cu headlight branch passes mat_spec/mat_shin_exp; render_shade.cu uses mat_shin_exp in powf(ndoth, mat_shin_exp); no geom_id/pixel/coordinate special cases
mat_shin_exp_semantic.conclusion: product tracks the material exponent over two distinct values and matches the reference exactly at both; a fixed 64 would not. The fix is a semantic fix, not fixture fitting. cam0 unchanged is consistent with mat1 (sphere/cylinder) being visible only in cam1.
mat_shin_exp_semantic.pre_fix_note: the recorded pre-fix deviations (332/43200 >1 LSB etc.) are delivery history; reproducing them needs a product kernel variant, which QA does not build

sources_compared: QA f32 recompute from model-312.json fields (world body xquat identity verified from scene-315.mjb)

placeholder_not_read.exception: slot 62 mesh_texcoord is passed into sample_texture, dereferenced only when mesh_texcoordadr[mesh] >= 0; scene-a has -1 so it is never read

bvh_id.host_header: header[2i]=byte offset, header[2i+1]=byte length for 5 sections (scene_meta, scene_params, mesh_meta, mesh_params, mesh_offsets)
bvh_id.section_start_offsets: 40 + 16k bytes (spacing 16 bytes; absolute offset not 16-byte aligned)

render_gate.compile_path: RenderKernel::compile -> compile_render_artifact (WARP_1_15_RENDER + RecipePurpose::Render + check_render_ptx); no bypass
